newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Svyazinvest gets no money from auctions.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Svyazinvest gets no money from auctions.

text.p: Russian telecoms holding company Svyazinvest will take over the stakes owned by the government in three information companies, but is unlikely to get any money from the sale of 49 percent of its own shares to portfolio investors, Svyazinvest's CEO said on Tuesday.
Nail Ismailov told Reuters that Svyazinvest would get shares in NII Giprosvyaz, a scientific research institute, Yekaterinburgskoi GTS (telecom) and AO Tsentralny Telegraf.
But he said the company would not profit from the sale by the Communications Ministry of 25 percent of Svyazinvest to foreign portfolio investors and 24 percent to domestic portfolio investors.
